description: Parent layers to another layer (or remove the parent), keeping their current position on screen, or with jump (Alt/Option while parenting): the child takes the parent's transform and jumps to it

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

jump.description: Parent with jump: keep the child's transform values relative to the new parent instead of its place on screen. Default false

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true

parent.description: Parent layer index; omit to remove the parent

name: parent_layers
title: Parent Layers
